sealed_exclusion.by_construction_rule: Codex round 37 #2: BY_CONSTRUCTION_DISJOINT is a MACHINE-VERIFIED PARTITION, not an attestation. The ledger entry cites a partition_receipt (committed, ATTEST_SEALED_PARTITION) binding the sealed manifest (key/sha256/VersionId) to a COMPLEMENTARY NOMINATION READ pool (key/sha256/VersionId + dev_aggregate_sha256 + dev_count) and asserting partition_verified. The mint verifies the complementary pool is one it actually reads AND that the read pool's ACTUAL identities reproduce the receipt's dev_aggregate — so nomination_split ⊆ dev-half ⇒ disjoint from the sealed half, proven WITHOUT reading a sealed identity. Cross-language seals (no nomination read-pool complement) and the QUARANTINED cv17 pool therefore CANNOT be BY_CONSTRUCTION — they require CLEARED_FOR_EXCLUSION (identity anti-join), and the quarantined pool additionally a separate quarantine_clearance.
sealed_exclusion.mechanism: identity-only, ledger-adjudicated. The mint NEVER fetches sealed manifest bytes. Each of the 11 pinned SEALED pools needs one ACTIVE ledger entry: BY_CONSTRUCTION_DISJOINT (a committed disjointness record; NO identities — the correct disposition for the dev/sealed complements and the cross-language seals, so an untouched seal is never read) or CLEARED_FOR_EXCLUSION (a supplied identity authority reproducing the committed aggregate).
sealed_exclusion.quarantine_rule: the quarantined cv17-test-v1-sealed pool needs a SEPARATE quarantine_clearance record (authorizes=CLEAR_SEALED_QUARANTINE), distinct from its ordinary admission — ordinary admission can never implicitly clear the quarantine.
